text:
alex: tiny non-work victory post  our hosted API just hit 2,000,000 requests this month. not a press release but wow. thank you all :tada::rocket:
nina: holy moly that's awesome!!! huge props to runtime & infra teams for smoothing peak QPS :raised_hands:
trevor: shoutout to the queueing tweaks and the new KV cache warmup. p95 dropped noticeably :chart_with_upwards_trend:
sabin: we should celebrate. poll (react): :sparkles: virtual fireworks / :pizza: pizza in office / :sticker: stickers / :coffee: coffee & donuts
elena: :sticker: (i collect laptop stickers)
ops-bot: DeployBot: Canary deployed new batching policy at 02:14 UTC. No rollbacks. Observed 11% throughput improvement in first hour.
alex: stickers are winning right now. merch team, if youre listening, can we get a small run: "2M requests  Redwood Inference"? also maybe a phone wallpaper pack for remote folks
nina: i'll make a quick mock for sticker art. small prize for the winning design = coffee + sticker pack :coffee::art:
trevor: i can help QA the mock, also i'll bring tiny sparklers to the office for the photo (harmless, tbh everyone be careful :wink:)
sabin: snacks: pizza + vegan slices + a gluten-free option. @facilities will that work?
elena: remote folks  i'll host a 10-min ask-me-anything and toast tomorrow at 09:30 PT
ops-bot: CalendarBot: Event created "2M Requests Mini-Toast"  tomorrow 09:30 PT. Zoom link auto-included.
alex: love it. personal thanks to the oncall folks who kept latency steady during the traffic surge yesterday  you know who you are. small tradition idea: plaque in the kitchen for each milestone (we can keep a small stack)
nina: plaque idea = adorable. can we engrave "reliability > everything"? kidding but maybe a short line acknowledging teams
trevor: also meme: who wants to make a tiny GIF of a server doing a victory dance? i'll animate it if someone gives me a concept :joy:
sabin: concept: tiny server with arms raising a coffee mug :coffee:
elena: RSVP to the toast in the calendar. congrats everyone  still buzzing :sparkles:
